intro: Developed a full-stack web-based video conferencing app with real-time communication features.
description: Created a modern video conferencing solution using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS for the frontend, with WebRTC for video/audio streaming. The backend is built with Node.js and Socket.IO for real-time signaling and JWT authentication.
title: V.C.Ation : Video Conferencing Application
contributions: Developed a responsive frontend using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS
Implemented peer-to-peer video and audio communication using WebRTC
Integrated real-time chat and device toggles (mic/cam)
Built room creation and joining logic with Socket.IO
Secured backend with JWT authentication and managed user sessions
Designed a signaling server to coordinate WebRTC connections between peers
drawbacks: Cannot support two systems on Different Wifi/Optical Networks
Requires stable connectivity for optimal performance
Limited to browser-based usage without native app support
futureScope: Increases scalability to support larger groups
Implement SFU (Selective Forwarding Unit) for better performance
Add support for mobile devices and native apps
Explore integration with third-party services for additional features
